01 / Message input

Start with the original headers

Maximum 256 KiB. EML bodies are ignored. Binary Outlook .msg files are not supported. In Gmail, use “Show original”; in other clients, find the message source.

Evidence, not a verdict.

Header fields can be forged. A reported “pass” does not make a message safe, and a reported “fail” does not establish malicious intent. HomingPigeon does not perform DNS authentication or verify signatures.

Your investigation, your choice.

OSINT links open only after you confirm the indicator and destination. A provider may log or retain that indicator. Local and reserved indicators have no external lookup links.
